text:
David (head of reliability): following up from today's all-hands — posting the RCA link and the concrete next steps from leadership Q&A. RCA: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-04-02/cache-shard-imbalance (internal). please confirm owners here.

Zoe (SRE): skimmed the RCA. issue summary looks right: uneven shard compaction caused hot-keys and p99 spikes for ~10m (06:05-06:15 UTC). mitigation was to throttle compaction and promote a temporary sticky routing rule.

Mei (product): PMs asked for a 1-sentence Console timeline entry + a short FAQ to explain what sticky routing means. Luis can you take support lead?

Luis (customer-succ): yep. need the exact impacted org export and a suggested plain-language blurb. where's the impact blurb in the doc?

David (head of reliability): impact section in RCA: "~10 minutes of elevated tail latency affecting ~5% of dedicated-route customers between 06:05-06:15 UTC; mitigation: throttled compaction and applied sticky routing to spread load." i'll DM the org list to support shortly.

Omar (platform): will add a per-shard hot-key metric to Console: metrics path proposal inference.cache.shard_hotkey_counter and inference.cache.shard_utilization gauge. ETA 72h.

Zoe (SRE): also proposing two alerts: hotkey_rate > 0.1% sustained 5m, and shard_utilization > 85% for 3m. adding to RCA metrics section.

Riya (eng): quick ask from runtime team: can we include shard_id in spans so we can trace compaction runs to latency? i'll open a tiny PR.

inc-bot: automation: checklist created in RCA and tasks assigned to owners.

Zoe (SRE): owner list i'm taking: rollout of compaction throttle, preflight script for compaction config, and the rollback hook. i'll post the preflight script here once ready.

Mei (product): putting a roadmap note: "improve shard observability" as P1 for Optimize next quarter. added.

Luis (customer-succ): once i get the org export i'll draft the Console blurb + target email. ETA: EOD.

Omar (platform): confirming dashboards + metric wiring. i'll add a per-tenant drilldown to the Console panels.

Riya (eng): PR opened for shard_id trace tag: https://redwood.internal/git/add-shard-tag. pinging tracing team for review.

Zoe (SRE): preflight script posted: https://redwood.internal/tools/compaction-preflight.sh. contains smoke checks: ensure no shard util > 80% and no hotkey > threshold. please validate.

Mei (product): support / product will pair on wording. suggested one-line for Console: "Brief increase in latency for a subset of dedicated routing customers; engineers applied a fix and are adding monitoring to prevent recurrence." feedback?

Luis (customer-succ): that should work. i'll soften language if legal asks.

David (head of reliability): leadership requested a 30-minute blameless review next Wed to walk timeline, decisions, and follow-ups. Zoe, can you schedule and include logs + deploy metadata?

Zoe (SRE): scheduling now. will attach timeline snippet and the compaction job logs.

inc-bot: deploy started by Zoe to canary pool gpux-dedicated-7 (canary=7%)  build 2026.04.02-compaction-throttle.

Zoe (SRE): canary steady at 7% after 20m. bumping to 25% in 10m if no regressions. monitoring the new hotkey panels.

Omar (platform): small follow-up: i need the exact metric name for hotkey counter to wire alerts. Zoe / Riya, confirm the metric names in RCA so dashboards pick them up consistently.

Riya (eng): confirmed metric names in RCA: inference.cache.shard_hotkey_counter and inference.cache.shard_utilization.

Mei (product): added support FAQ draft to the RCA attachments. Luis, take a look and edit.

Luis (customer-succ): editing now. will post final copy here and then push to #support.

David (head of reliability): final ask: if you own an action, please add a short ETA inline in the RCA checklist (date or EOD) so we can close the follow-up loop. thanks all for the quick responses.

Zoe (SRE): added ETAs: compaction throttle runbook (ETA today), preflight script validation (ETA today), rollback hook (ETA tomorrow).

inc-bot: deploy to 25% started by Zoe  build 2026.04.02-compaction-throttle.

Zoe (SRE): 25% stable after 35m. proceeding to 100% in 15m if no new signals. will update RCA when complete.

David (head of reliability): appreciate the swift action. we'll touch on lessons at the next all-hands and publish a short post-incident note in the ops wiki. :sparkles:
